core_obligations: Display the chain Ra_* Rp_*(Lp^*K tensor Lq^*M) = Ra_*(K tensor Rp_* Lq^* M) = Ra_*(K tensor La^* Rb_* M) = Ra_*K tensor Rb_*M.
Justify each equality: the first is the factorization f = a composed p; the second and fourth are projection formulas; the third is the base-change comparison under tor-independence.
Verify that the composed isomorphism coincides with the map of equation-kunneth; the source omits this verification - carry it as an explicit obligation.
Global case: if S = Spec(A) is affine, apply R Gamma(S, -) to both sides of equation-kunneth; the source marks the step 'details omitted' - carry it as an explicit obligation.
proof_roadmap: Four-equality chain; projection formulas; base-change comparison; compatibility verification; global application.
difficulty_reason: A chain-of-isomorphisms argument whose substance is the compatibility of the composed map with the Kunneth morphism, carried as an explicit obligation.
